> Bangalore · Fresh stock, auto-updated.

A clean, mobile-friendly page that shows what's on the shelf. Pulls live data from Google Sheets — no login, no build step, just open and share.

## Live

[![Open the live page](https://img.shields.io/badge/open%20the%20live%20page-%E2%9C%93-green?style=for-the-badge)](https://drjphilip.github.io/maatti-inventory/)

[![Preview — logo and header (table hidden)](data:image/png;base64,)](https://drjphilip.github.io/maatti-inventory/)

## Features

- **Live inventory** from Google Sheets — refreshes every 60 seconds
- **In-stock first** — out-of-stock rows dim, never hidden
- **Weight-aware** product names (e.g. *Tulsi · 500g*)
- **Tabular numerals** on prices and counts — no jitter when values change
- **No login required** — anyone with the link can view
- **Mobile-first** — tight columns, no horizontal scroll

## Tech Stack

- Vanilla HTML / CSS / JS — no framework, no build step
- Google Sheets `gviz/tq` JSON API for live data
- Playfair Display + Inter for the editorial look
- Auto-refresh on a 60-second timer

## Setup

1. Make sure both `Inventory` and `Products` tabs are shared as **Anyone with the link can view**
2. Upload `index.html` to any static host: GitHub Pages, Netlify, Vercel
3. Done — the page updates itself
